description: In a regular cardinal order of uncountable cofinality, the closure points of every self-map form a club.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.closurePoints_club.{u} {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] [WellFoundedLT α]
  [IsRegularCardinalOrder α] (hα : Cardinal.aleph0 < Order.cof α) (f : α → α) :
  IsClub (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Clubs.closurePoints f)
